_comment: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 for a full (not LoRA) fine-tune of an 8B model on 4x A40 48GB.
Memory arithmetic: 8B params in bf16 = 16 GB, gradients 16 GB, and Adam's two
moments plus fp32 master weights = 8B x 12 bytes = 96 GB. That is ~128 GB, well
past a single 48 GB A40, so all three must be sharded -- hence stage 3.
Sharded 4 ways that is ~32 GB/GPU, leaving ~16 GB for activations.
offload_optimizer is ON by default because 32 GB/GPU plus activations is close
enough to 48 GB that a long sequence can tip it into OOM hours into a run. It
costs throughput (optimizer step moves over PCIe). If the timing run is stable
with headroom, set device to "none" and re-measure -- that is the faster config.
